How it works.

Your next ads, from creators whose posts already sell. Each is a post a creator chose to make for their own audience, so it reads as theirs, not as an ad. You license the best of them, with every fee and term agreed inside the rules you set.

01Run by Tano

Sourcing

Tano finds creators whose audiences buy from you and whose posts already work as ads, working from your creator personas and within your guardrails. Each is scored on how likely they are to post and sell, so the creators you gift to are the ones whose content is most likely to work in your ads.

02Run by Tano

Onboarding

Tano’s agents write to each creator personally, choose a gift from your products and set them up with a code and link connected to your Shopify store. A portal invite follows for sales and payouts, so the first post can follow within days of delivery.

03Run by Tano

Post recommendation

Tano reviews every post against your ad account and content library: the sales it drove, how it ranks across the programme, how quickly the product appears and whether it is clear of music, stickers and other brands. The posts that already sell and pass are put forward for you to license.

04Run by Tano

Invitations

Your best performers from the last 30 days are invited to make something specific for your content library, each invitation with the reward, the deadline and the usage rights, such as two months as a partnership ad, agreed before they say yes. Creators know what they are making and what it is for.

05Run by Tano

Whitelisting and licence

You set a rate card and Tano negotiates inside it, agreeing the fee, the contract and the usage period with each creator from your contract templates. Once it is signed, the ad code is delivered and the post goes live as a partnership ad, with the licence period starting that day.

    Ranked on the orders each creator’s code and link have driven for you. £1,240 in 14 days puts a post in the top 10% of your programme.

  • Posts built to run as ads

    Format and craft that already work on your account: a hook in the first two seconds, product on screen throughout, no on-screen text to re-cut.

  • Cleared for Meta before you see them

    Licensed music checked against Instagram’s own post data. No link stickers, no TV or film on screen, and no other brand in the frame.

Recruit, post, amplify. Then do itagain, and again.

Every round of creator content shapes the next. Tano’s agents manage thousands of creator relationships, with your team setting the creative direction and choosing what goes behind paid spend.

  1. 01

    We set the standard for content

    Tell us what your team needs: demonstrations, tutorials, and everyday product stories. You review the first creators and their work, and your feedback becomes Creator Personas: the quality standard every later recruit is measured against.

  2. 02

    We keep creators posting with rewards

    Creators choose from an agreed product range and share their experience in their own words. Tano manages outreach, onboarding, gifting and follow-up, whilst rewards give creators a reason to return. Monthly output targets are set against what your product costs to seed, so your volume never outruns your margin.

  3. 03

    We turn the strongest content into ads

    Shop organic posts to test, or invite a proven creator to make something specific. Tano manages the invitation, delivery, payment, and usage rights. Fees and licence terms are agreed before content runs.

  4. 04

    We iterate on your programme over time

    Your team’s selections and paid results help refine future recruitment, coaching and invitations. Tano also tests outreach, gifting, and rewards to learn what keeps the right creators contributing.
